p2StorageReady.summary: Checks whether the isolated P2 user-file store is ready.
p2StorageReady.returns: Boolean readiness; does not imply SD support.
prerequisites: Import P2 Storage and its declared dependencies.

examples.title: Use P2 user file storage ready
examples.explanation: Block notation: Checks whether the isolated P2 user-file store is ready. Boolean readiness; does not imply SD support.

notes: Candidate extension-9 firmware required; not in the reviewed revision-8 installer. General LittleFS files isolated under /flash/user-. Flat names up to 48 ASCII characters, no traversal or program-file access. One current read handle. Append/read chunks max 512 bytes; append returns byte count or -1. No formatting API. SD unsupported. Hardware acceptance pending.
Source: boards\propeller2\integration\libraries\P2 Storage.ubl. Examples are illustrative block notation, not hardware acceptance tests.

p2FileAppend.summary: Appends a text or byte chunk to a flat user file without accessing program storage.
p2FileAppend.returns: Written byte count, or -1; maximum chunk 512 bytes.
prerequisites: Import P2 Storage and its declared dependencies.
inputs: 1. P2 append bytes: text; library example hello.
2. to file: text; library example notes.txt.

2. bytes from file: text; library example notes.txt.
